evidence: Job listing page displays 8 jobs with accurate count "Showing 8 jobs". All listings are clickable and show complete details.
All job cards display: title, company, industry, employment type, location, salary range, posting date, and required skills.

Filters work individually and in combination. Selecting Industry filters to 2 jobs, Location (Remote) filters to 2 jobs, combining Remote + Part-time filters to 1 job. Clear filters button restores full list of 8 jobs.
Search matches skills (React -> 1 result), company names (TechCorp -> 2 results), case-insensitive (techcorp lowercase -> 2 results). Results and count update immediately.

Job details page displays: Senior Frontend Developer (title), TechCorp Solutions (company), Technology (industry), Full-time (employment type), San Francisco, CA (location), $140k - $180k (salary), Posted Jan 15 (date), full description with responsibilities and requirements, React TypeScript CSS Node.js (required skills).

Form submission successful with valid data (name, valid email john@example.com, phone, message). Success notification: "Application submitted! Your application for Senior Frontend Developer at TechCorp Solutions has been sent." Form cleared after submission.

Form validation prevents submission when required Name field is empty (field gains focus). Form validation prevents submission with invalid email format "invalid-email" (email field gains focus). Browser HTML5 validation prevents submission of syntactically invalid data.

Dashboard displays: 5 Active Jobs, 4 Total Applications. Lists 5 job postings: Senior Frontend Developer (3 applications), Product Designer (1), Marketing Manager (0), Part-Time Content Writer (0), DevOps Engineer (0). Each job shows title, industry, type, location, salary, posting date.
Clicking applications button opens expandable list showing all 3 applications for Senior Frontend Developer. Each application displays: applicant name, email, phone, message, and submission date.

Applications display complete information as distinct records: John Doe (john@example.com, 555-0123, full message, Yesterday), Alex Johnson (alex.j@email.com, 555-0101, full message, Jan 20), Maria Garcia (maria.g@email.com, 555-0102, full message, Jan 22).

Submitted application (John Doe, john@example.com, 555-0123, message) appears in employer dashboard with success confirmation visible. Application shows with submission date "Yesterday", appears exactly once under Senior Frontend Developer job, with all submitted information displayed correctly.

Job created with all required fields: Senior Backend Developer, Technology industry, Full-time type, Boston MA location, $120k-$160k salary, full description, Java skill. Success notification: "Job posted successfully!" New job appears in employer dashboard and job-seeker listing with accurate details and "Posted Yesterday" date.

issue: Duplicate application allowed. System permitted second application for same job using same email address (john@example.com) that was already submitted.
actual: Second application with john@example.com for Senior Frontend Developer job was accepted and showed success notification "Application submitted!" instead of preventing duplicate.

issue: Data not persisting after page reload. Published job and submitted applications lost after navigation reload.
actual: After reloading employer dashboard: (1) newly created "Senior Backend Developer" job disappeared; (2) Active Jobs count dropped from 6 to 5; (3) Total Applications dropped from 4 to 3; (4) Frontend Developer applications show 2 instead of 4, indicating duplicate application also not persisted.

evidence: Submission dates display accurately: John Doe application showed "Yesterday" immediately after submission (correct for same-day submission); Senior Backend Developer job showed "Posted Yesterday" immediately after creation. Existing applications show historical dates (Jan 20, Jan 22) correctly. Dates update relative to user's current date.

Delete button shows confirmation dialog: "This will permanently delete "Marketing Manager" and all its applications. This action cannot be undone." After confirming deletion, job removed from dashboard, Active Jobs count decreased from 5 to 4. Job no longer appears in job-seeker listing.

issue: Job creation validation does not enforce salary constraints. System allows jobs with invalid salary ranges (max < min) and missing required fields.
actual: Job "Test Job" was created and posted with minimum salary $100k and maximum salary $50k (invalid: max < min). No validation error shown. Missing required fields (Industry, Employment Type, Location, Skills) also did not prevent submission. Job displays as "$100k - $50k" in both employer and job-seeker views.

evidence: Search criteria immediately refresh results. Typing "Nurse" in search box immediately filtered results from 8 jobs to 1 job (Registered Nurse). Result count updated instantly from "Showing 8 jobs" to "Showing 1 jobs". Clear filters button appeared. No delay observed.

issue: Edit job functionality not found. No edit button or menu option exists in employer dashboard.
actual: Employer dashboard displays jobs with two buttons per job: applications count and a menu button. Menu button only opens delete confirmation dialog. No edit option available. No edit interface found anywhere in the application for modifying published jobs.
